Recovery overlays are complete and well-calibrated: metric_risk probes directly target the 40% and turnaround-time claims with baseline/methodology challenges, and overclaim_risk probes force mechanism-level answers (mutex vs channel vs atomic).

Signal-weight 3.0 dimensions fire directly on the highest-value resume claims (Redis latency, maker-checker workflow, LLM prompt flow) rather than being distributed uniformly across lower-stakes topics.
issues: Both openers invite narrative ('what was the hardest scaling problem', 'what was the core problem') rather than forcing an immediate analytical position or hypothesis — they are anchored but not causal-challenge style, costing points toward 8.5+.
